name: Desktop Widget
description: Desktop widgets (clock, calendar, agenda, weather, photos, battery, Bambu Lab) for GNOME Shell 50. Lightweight, runs in gnome-shell. Calendar shows event dots and Agenda lists upcoming events from Evolution/Online Accounts. Photos can rotate from local images or your Immich library with fallback. Bambu Lab shows live 3D print progress from a self-hosted bridge. Drag, resize, snap to grid, multi-monitor, and fully configurable.
